plan.name: 2-Week Reconditioning Starter (L4-L5 Precaution)
plan.description: Two-week introductory general strength program for a 42-year-old male post L4-L5 herniation. Avoids heavy spinal loading and loaded spinal flexion; focuses on safe reconditioning, core stability, hip/glute strength, and unloaded or machine-based progressions.

goals.name: Safe reconditioning
goals.description: Rebuild general strength, improve core control and hip/glute capacity while avoiding heavy spinal compression and loaded spinal flexion.

equipment.name: Gym — machines, dumbbells, cable, machines for leg press/row

checkpoints.name: End of Week 1 check-in
questions: Any increase in back pain since starting?

checkpoints.name: End of Week 2 assessment
questions: Comfort with progression to heavier loading (yes/no)

notifications.message: Ensure medical/physio clearance before starting. If not cleared, pause and obtain clearance.
